data.description: Large Plot | Corner Unit | Close to Lake
data.long_description:
Experience comfortable family living in this spacious villa, ideally located in a serene and well-established community. Set on a large plot, this home offers both privacy and ample outdoor space, perfect for relaxation and entertaining.

The property features a well-designed layout with bright living and dining areas, allowing plenty of natural light throughout. Its prime location close to the lake and park adds to the peaceful lifestyle this home provides.

Villa Details:
• 3 Bedroom + Study Room
• 3 Bathrooms
• Closed Kitchen
• Spacious Balcony
• Large Plot
• Close to Lake and Park
• Vacant

Vacant and ready to move in, this villa is an excellent opportunity for both end-users and investors seeking a quality home in a prime location.
